summary: Master the art of PPE selection and usage with our specialized training. Safeguard your workforce and minimize risks with practical, hands-on learning.
lede: PPE training prepares safety professionals, operations managers, and compliance officers to assess workplace hazards and select suitable protective equipment. Participants learn to match equipment to hazards, develop user training, monitor PPE use, and plan inspection, maintenance, and replacement. The course also covers cost analysis and program improvement, helping teams account for usability, operational needs, and available resources.
audienceIntro: This course serves safety professionals, operations managers, and compliance officers responsible for implementing and managing comprehensive PPE programs that protect workers while meeting regulatory and organizational requirements.
modules: Eye, Face, and Head Protection Systems
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites required. Basic understanding of workplace safety concepts is helpful but not required. Participants should bring examples of current PPE challenges or workplace hazard scenarios from their organizations for practical application during exercises.
